raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: s2geometry
  version: "0.14.0"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/google/s2geometry/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8c1f0a4b98472ed9df9807f5ec10ee57928cca388e16c13f430b652790d3ad8b
  patches:
    # missing DLL exports on windows (data)
    - patches/0001-dllexport.patch
    # backport https://github.com/google/s2geometry/pull/609
    - patches/0002-S2PointArray-replace-alignof-expression-with-alignof.patch
    # backport https://github.com/google/s2geometry/pull/637
    - patches/0003-Fix-MSVC-build.patch

build:
  number: 1

outputs:
  - package:
      name: s2geometry
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake >=3.25,<4
        - ninja
      host:
        - openssl
        - libabseil
      run:
        - libabseil
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('s2geometry', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            # test that custom header is present; it got removed upstream in
            # https://github.com/google/s2geometry/commit/dabeea21c0261cb2e449d28f3034df1e12eaf223
            - s2/base/port.h
      - files:
          recipe:
            - run_test.bat
            - run_test.sh
        script:
          - if: unix
            then: bash run_test.sh
          - if: win
            then: run_test.bat

  - package:
      name: s2geometry-python
    build:
      script: install_python
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: ninja
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: python
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: cmake-build-extension
        - swig
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools >=80
        - setuptools-scm >=8
        - libabseil
        - cmake-build-extension
        - openssl
      run:
        - libabseil
        - openssl
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - s2geometry
      - files:
          source:
            - src/python/s2geometry_test.py
        script:
          - python ./src/python/s2geometry_test.py
        requirements:
          run:
            - python

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Computational geometry and spatial indexing on the sphere.
  homepage: https://s2geometry.io/
  repository: https://github.com/google/s2geometry

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - zklaus
    - benbovy
    - hobu
    - h-vetinari
